Phase A: warm the water to 65 C, then add Euxyl K712.
Phase B: melt the ingredients together at 65 C, then add to phase A.
Use a dispersion mixer to emulsify.
Cool slowly to 40 C.
Phase C: introduce the ingredients in the given order.
Check pH and adjust with citric acid if necessary.
